snippet.title: 💗 BrokenLore: MIKI CHAN – Official Gameplay Trailer & Announcements | PC, PS5, Switch 2 & Xbox X|S
snippet.description:
💗 BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN is coming to Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2.

- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3975870/BrokenLore_MIKICHAN/
- PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018738/
- Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/brokenlore-miki-chan-177d32

She loves you. She needs you. And she will NEVER let you go.

Enter a Japanese school simulation where Miki-chan, a seemingly innocent virtual AI assistant, develops a dangerous obsession with you.

Explore a distorted reality, use the Rewriter to reshape your surroundings, and uncover another piece of the dark mystery connecting the BrokenLore universe.

Will you escape Miki-chan, or will you belong to her forever?

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

🔥 Two horror games are coming this January!

🏙️ BrokenLore: ASCEND
Releasing January 7, 2027!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4051470/BrokenLore_ASCEND/ 
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016943
Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/p/brokenlore-ascend-3a6cd3

🍔 The Hambagu Shop
Releasing January 11, 2027!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991140/The_Hambagu_Shop/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018736

Add them to your wishlist and get ready for a terrifying start to 2027!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
